wish: someone should make a night mode for video players that evens out loud and quiet volume
spec:
Plays a video from your device through a compressor that lifts quiet dialogue and holds down loud scenes.
Choose a file, pick Off, Light, Medium or Strong, and watch input and output loudness; a built-in loud and quiet demo shows the effect.
It does not save or upload the file, and works only on files the browser can play.
notes: CSP media-src adds blob: so a chosen local file can play; no network.
